entities.label: One uncreated God
entities.definition: Uncreated, eternal, transcendent, personal, free, omnipotent; truth and love; one undivided divine nature

entities.label: One divine nature
entities.definition: One nature wholly possessed by each divine person; not a fourth agent and not partitioned into thirds

entities.label: Father
entities.definition: Uncreated divine person; eternally Father of the Son

entities.label: Son / eternal Word
entities.definition: Uncreated divine person, eternally begotten of the Father; becomes incarnate without ceasing to be divine

entities.label: Holy Spirit
entities.definition: Uncreated divine person; proceeds eternally; giver of life and sanctifier

entities.label: Created order
entities.definition: All contingent created reality: visible and invisible; freely created and continuously sustained

entities.label: Visible material world
entities.definition: Created reality with its own laws, goodness, development, and creaturely interactions

entities.label: Angels
entities.definition: Incorporeal created personal spirits with intellect and will; messengers and ministers of God

entities.label: Fallen angels / demons
entities.definition: Created spirits that rejected God; not a second primordial deity or coeternal evil substance

entities.label: Humanity
entities.definition: Embodied spiritual persons made in God's image, with reason, freedom, responsibility, social life

entities.label: Human body
entities.definition: Material aspect of the human person; not an evil prison by nature

entities.label: Human spiritual soul
entities.definition: Spiritual principle of an embodied human person; the human being is a unity, not two persons

entities.label: First parents in the doctrine of the Fall
entities.definition: Figures in Catholic original-sin teaching; Genesis account uses figurative language

entities.label: Israel / covenant people
entities.definition: People called by God in the history of revelation and covenant

entities.label: Jesus Christ
entities.definition: The incarnate Son: one divine person having divine and human natures; not a fourth divine person

entities.label: Human nature assumed by the Son
entities.definition: True humanity with human intellect and will, united to the one divine person of the Son

entities.label: Catholic Church
entities.definition: People of God, Body of Christ, Temple of the Holy Spirit; historical and sacramental community

entities.label: Grace
entities.definition: Unmerited divine gift that heals and elevates persons toward participation in divine life; not a material beam

entities.label: Sacraments
entities.definition: Seven instituted ritual signs that effect the grace they signify; neither mere labels nor physical-fluid transfer

entities.label: Eucharist
entities.definition: Catholic sacrament of Christ's real presence and memorial of his Paschal mystery

entities.label: Saints
entities.definition: Those sharing in the life of Christ, especially the blessed in heaven; communion across the Church

entities.label: Renewed creation
entities.definition: Transformed creation at final fulfillment, not rejection of materiality as intrinsically evil

entities.label: Mary, Mother of Jesus
entities.definition: Created human person; mother of the incarnate Son according to his human nature, called Theotokos because Jesus is one divine person; Mary is not a divine person.

processes.claim: God freely calls created reality into existence from nothing.
processes.guardrail: not a chronological change within preexisting space or time

processes.claim: Created things operate and develop through real created causes.
processes.guardrail: includes material processes, natural laws, meaningful creaturely freedom
a choice of created personal spirits; not origination of an independent darkness-god

processes.claim: Original human disobedience damages humanity's relation to God.
processes.guardrail: Genesis narrative has figurative literary language; avoid depicting it as straightforward documentary footage

processes.claim: God reveals himself and enters covenant with Israel.
processes.guardrail: not simply a mechanical contract between equivalent powers

processes.claim: The eternal Son assumes true humanity in Jesus Christ.
processes.guardrail: not a newly created divine person or a transformation of divine nature into human nature

processes.claim: Christ's Passion, death, Resurrection and exaltation.
processes.guardrail: central salvific transformation, not simply biological resuscitation

processes.claim: The risen Christ gives the Holy Spirit, who animates and sanctifies the Church.

processes.claim: Resurrection, judgment and renewal of creation in Christ.

distinction_rules: Divine nature is one; three divine persons are distinct without being three gods or one person in three costumes.
Eternal generation and procession are not chronological occurrences.
Jesus is the incarnate eternal Son: one divine person with divine and human natures, not two persons and not a fourth member of the Trinity.
Created persons and bodies differ from uncreated divine persons; angels are created spirits; fallen angels are not coeternal rivals.
Human body and soul form one human person; do not draw a detachable ghost as the entire Catholic anthropology.
Evil is not a second independently existing primordial divine substance; moral evil is tied to free creaturely rejection and sin.
Free creation and continuing divine conservation are distinct from material transfer between creatures.
Grace and the sacraments are not identical to material energy beams; physical water becomes specifically baptismal in a sacramental context.
Resurrection and the new creation affirm transformed embodiment and creation, rather than liberation from intrinsically wicked material existence.
Do not depict heavenly, purgatorial or infernal states as empirically located astronomical planets.
Mary is a created human mother of the incarnate Son, not a member of the Trinity and not the source of Christ's divine nature.
Heaven, hell and purgatory are distinguished states or destinies in Catholic teaching, not interchangeable afterlife planets; purgatory is purification for those destined for heaven.
visual_research_constraints: Every foreground theological actor, motif or event needs a source-scoped semantic casting entry.
Artistic ornament is allowed without formal meaning, but should not accidentally imply a contradictory doctrine.
Keep separate ontological/permanent relationships, historical events, ritual enactments, and eschatological fulfillment.
Film should represent one positive Catholic account, not a sequence of contrasts with other religions.
Never make a golden aura or flow automatically signify God, holiness, grace, goodness and physical energy at once.
Use words, iconography and narration when they outperform unlabeled abstractions.
The formal model is a thinking instrument; it does not automatically generate a work of art.

states.description: Participation in divine life and friendship with God, not spatial co-location
Moral rupture through created freedom; not an independent divine principle or a concrete dark substance
Sanctification through God's gift of grace; not a physical energy flow
Purification of those who die in God's grace but are not yet fully purified; distinct from hell
Definitive communion with the Trinity and beatific vision, not necessarily a physical location in space
Definitive self-exclusion from communion with God through unrepented mortal sin, not a rival divine realm
Final transformation and reunion of body and soul, not permanent disembodied existence
